description: One named grade per S9 CorruptionBand, keyed by the same lowercase word strategy/dungeon.rs spells. The snapshot carries corruption per cell as a band and never as the u8 it was banded from, so this table has four rows and can never have more.

notes: Every band is named so a capture, a bug report and a test can all say which grade they mean without quoting a saturation number.
Desaturation only ever falls as corruption rises: a cell the island has lost must never read livelier than a clean one.
